scenes.text: Imagine standing in a place where you could commit the perfect crime and legally get away with it.
This isn't some lawless island, it's a fifty-mile strip of land inside Yellowstone National Park known as the Zone of Death.
Because absolutely nobody lives in this specific sector, a legal jury cannot be formed, making prosecution literally impossible.
Would you ever dare to hike in this lawless zone? Tell me in the comments and follow for more!
